# anomaly_maintenance_windows (Data Source)

Returns all maintenance windows defined in nxs-anomaly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anomaly_maintenance_windows" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always set to "maintenance_windows".
- `maintenance_windows` (Attributes List) List of all maintenance windows, past and future. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--maintenance_windows))
